Raising the unconnected weight increases objective pressure for partial-pair Kelvin failures that fall through the kelvin_unrouted counter.

manager_rule: Kelvin stubs are a structural pre-condition of this board, not a response to prior-round failures. Before EVERY FR dispatch — including round 1 and any round that follows a Kelvin-clean prior round — enumerate all /SENSEC*_HI and /SENSEC*_LO net pairs from the board netlist, resolve their shunt inner-edge pad coordinates, and inject them at the HEAD of the stub nets list. If any Kelvin net cannot be resolved to a valid (non-null, non-(0,0)) pad coordinate, inject an explicit compile_failure for that net and abort the dispatch. Do not treat an absence of prior-round Kelvin failures as permission to omit Kelvin stubs; treat stub presence as unconditional.
